description: Na₄LiCl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiCl₆ octahedra, corners with five NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, corners with four NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.74-2.80 Å. Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-3°. There are four shorter (2.65 Å) and two longer (2.67 Å) Li-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to five Na and one Li atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₅Li octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-5°.
